scripts.build:onlyapp: tauri build --bundles app && node scripts/fix-mac-icon.mjs && node scripts/move-app.mjs
scripts.build:mac:arm: rustup target add aarch64-apple-darwin && tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app && node scripts/build-dmg.mjs --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:mac:intel: rustup target add x86_64-apple-darwin && tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin --bundles app && node scripts/build-dmg.mjs --target x86_64-apple-darwin
